breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the conflicting boundary conditions (Dirichlet and periodic). It resolved the ambiguity by correctly prioritizing the Dirichlet condition (u=0 on all boundaries), which aligns with the ground truth prompt that removed the periodic condition entirely. The agent's specification explicitly states to apply Dirichlet conditions.
